venue.continuity.label: Venue audio continuity
venue.continuity.about: Gap and duplicate targets, ready-to-play fallback songs and fenced speaker leases, so a venue night keeps playing through faults.
venue.continuity.cloud_surface_reason: Runtime gap and duplicate targets, fallback preparation and speaker leases have no Cloud screen

venue.fault_injection.label: Venue fault rehearsal
venue.fault_injection.about: Inject network, model and render faults on purpose in a test run to prove the night keeps playing.
venue.fault_injection.cloud_surface_reason: Fault injection is run by the venue test and chaos harness, not by a customer-facing Cloud control

venue.speakers.label: Venue speakers and zones
venue.speakers.about: Name the venue's speakers, group them into zones, and move or reconnect playback without two speakers playing at once.
venue.speakers.cloud_surface_reason: Speaker zone and lease models exist, but no speaker management page is mounted in Cloud

venue.staff_dashboard.label: Staff dashboard
venue.staff_dashboard.about: One screen for venue staff: what is playing, what is next, typed steering, pending versus applied changes and an always-visible Stop.
venue.staff_dashboard.cloud_surface_reason: Staff dashboard state and isolated route tests exist, but no staff venue page or routes are mounted in Cloud

venue.moderated_requests.label: Autopilot guest requests
venue.moderated_requests.about: Guest requests in a venue night go through Room moderation, are planned fairly and tell the guest honestly what happened.
venue.moderated_requests.cloud_surface_reason: The Room-to-Autopilot request planning bridge has no separate shipped Cloud interface

venue.learning.label: Venue learning
venue.learning.about: Learn a venue's taste from staff and guest feedback within a cap, with a reset, an explanation and a retention limit.
venue.learning.cloud_surface_reason: Venue feedback memory, adaptation caps and retention operate in the backend without a Cloud control

venue.rights_gate.label: Venue rights check
venue.rights_gate.about: Check music and model rights before each media operation in a venue and refuse the ones that are not cleared.
venue.rights_gate.cloud_surface_reason: Media and model rights checks are backend safety decisions without a person-facing Cloud page

venue.roles.label: Venue roles
venue.roles.about: Owner, manager, staff and guest roles decide who may steer, stop or change a venue night, and revoked devices lose access at once.
venue.roles.cloud_surface_reason: Role permissions and paired-device revocation are backend authorization services, not Cloud pages

venue.safe_gain.label: Safe venue loudness
venue.safe_gain.about: Cap automatic gain changes so Autopilot never makes the room suddenly louder.
venue.safe_gain.cloud_surface_reason: Automatic gain bounds are applied to venue playback decisions without a Cloud volume panel

venue.health.label: Venue health and alerts
venue.health.about: Audio health signals, operator alert thresholds with runbook links, redacted logs and rehearsed recovery.
venue.health.cloud_surface_reason: Audio health monitoring, alerts and recovery rehearsal are operator tooling with no Cloud dashboard

venue.soak.label: Long-session soak tools
venue.soak.about: Real venue workloads, gap and resource metrics and long soak and chaos runs that record their evidence.
venue.soak.cloud_surface_reason: Long-session soak and chaos evidence are generated by the command-line harness, not Cloud UI

venue.rollout_gates.label: Venue rollout gates
venue.rollout_gates.about: Phased rollout order, no-go gates for P0 blockers and a flag-off rollback check before any venue release.
venue.rollout_gates.cloud_surface_reason: Release phase ordering, readiness gates and flag rollback checks run as operational tooling
